If you're on Product Hunt, you probably don't feel behind on AI. This is a highly filtered group. At B43 we train dozens of people a week, and you'd be surprised how many of them do feel behind. This course was built around their exact questions. Unscary AI puts it on your iPhone as 42 short lessons on how ChatGPT and the rest actually work, and how to use them well. It needs iOS 26, and the whole course is free. Enjoy.

Launch tags:iOS•Education•Artificial Intelligence [...] We built Unscary AI so the course we teach in person can reach anyone who feels behind on AI. I'm Bryce Murray, founder of B43 in Columbia, Missouri, where we run AI training for small businesses in the Midwest and South. I have a PhD in Explainable AI. We built the course for our in-person workshops and refined it with hundreds of people. On your iPhone, you take it a few minutes at a time. It needs iOS 26, and the whole course is free, for everyone.  
  
What it is  
Unscary AI has 42 short, hands-on lessons on how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and the rest actually work, and how to use them well. Each lesson takes 3 to 8 minutes and shows one thing per screen.   
  
The proof we have [...] The proof we have  
We've trained hundreds and we've fine-tuned this content to help people. The lessons in the app are that same course. Our line at B43, "We take the scary out of AI," is something a client said unprompted, and it's our biggest compliment.  
  
One ask  
The first lesson is called "What is AI, really?" and takes 3 minutes. I'm asking you to try it and leave one comment here. You could tell me where it lost you, or post the AI question you've been afraid to ask the friend who uses ChatGPT for everything. One honest comment about the part that confused you helps me most.  
  
Thanks!  
Bryce
